issues.title: Reduce complexity - GameChannelsWithTour
issues.body:
The `GameChannelsWithTour` causes a warning related to method complexity.

It's not actually a complex method, I think the complexity is just down to the way we declare the data.

We should try refactoring the tour content, to reduce the complexity.

Once we have no methods with complexity above 12, we should introduce it as a linter error:
![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/1108513/1d8ca63c-1bff-4eb5-a944-d65a34b2667b)
